input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Section 2.2 binds Customer to Vendor as sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services for the entire three-year term, with no category limit beyond the term, no 12-month cap, and no automatic exit for service-level or delivery failures, so it fails the fallback and sits in walk-away territory (exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance-based exit). Section 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer has made no exclusivity commitment directly conflicts with Section 2.2, and the precedence provision in the second Section 2.2 resolves only Order Form/exhibit conflicts, not this internal contradiction. We therefore take the preferred position and make Vendor a non-exclusive provider, which removes the conflict and requires no other changes.

proposal.summary: Make Vendor a non-exclusive provider in Section 2.2
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We removed the sole-and-exclusive provider commitment in Section 2.2 so we remain free to source hosted analytics services elsewhere, consistent with Section 12.3's no-exclusivity acknowledgement.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
